analysis:
Examined all eight primary analyses and the supplied source replay against the canonical index and selected TB-002/TB-011 definitions. No independently supported security regression qualifies. Replay is incomplete (53 source units omitted), so this conclusion does not validate all implementation claims in the analyses.
The verified changes introduce automatic selected-model residency recovery, include recovery in Autopilot exclusion and shutdown cancellation, and add an availability policy releasing busy, unselected adoptions. ProviderLoop+SelectedModelPlacementPolicy.swift:25-33 protects selected/pinned models and honors holds, dwell and leases; :41-48 withdraws adoption and publishes capacity without cancelling existing requests. ProviderLoop+Autopilot.swift:213 queues recovery after successful victim unload. ProviderLoop+Capacity.swift:82 schedules recovery on the capacity tick. These interactions primarily affect A-018, TB-007, T-029 and TB-012/T-059; no changed encryption, credential, attestation or billing control is established.
Material integration questions remain: verify ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery.swift's final load admission after suspension against add-on hold, drain, shutdown and current memory ownership, including cancellation settlement and attempt cleanup. Confirm adoption withdrawal actually prevents new admission while preserving in-flight completion. ProviderLoop+Serve.swift:493 includes recovery in shutdown cancellation, but :519 delegates unloading to a helper whose exact source is omitted from replay; review the reported 15-second retirement limit and cache clearing with outstanding native owners against T-010/T-028. Also verify the reported Lifecycle.swift:107-128 disconnected-drain success path against disconnect cancellation, terminal/accounting delivery and connection-bound authorization invalidation (A-009, T-053). Missing implementations are coverage limits, not observed missing controls. The new automatic recovery and adoption-release policy should be reconciled with A-018/T-059 availability assumptions.
